install.title: Install Kolo
install.text: Open it from your home screen, without the address bar
install.ios: Tap {share} and choose {add} “Add to Home Screen”

steps.title: Welcome to Kolo
steps.text: Word sets and smart review. This tour takes less than a minute.

steps.title: Create a set
steps.text: Tap “Create Set” and add words with a translation, explanation and example — or import a ready-made list.
steps.tip: A quiz needs at least 4 words in a set.

steps.title: Learn with flashcards
steps.text: Flip a card and rate how well you remember the word. Perigee, our review engine, decides when to show it again.
steps.tip: On a keyboard: Space flips, 1–4 rates. On a phone: swipe right if you know it, left if you don't.

steps.title: Test yourself
steps.text: Six kinds of quiz tasks — from picking a translation to writing the word — plus three games: Speed round, Survival and Match pairs.
steps.tip: In quiz settings you can keep only the tasks you need.

steps.title: Watch your progress
steps.text: Day streaks, achievements and stats. Come back every day — Kolo shows only the words that are due.
steps.tip: Your profile has an activity calendar and every achievement.

steps.title: All set!
steps.text: Create your first set and start learning.
